invention.ref: Earliest known reference to a corkscrew, England
invention.ref_zh: 英格兰出现关于开瓶螺旋的最早记载

patent.ref: Rev. Samuel Henshall granted the first corkscrew patent, England
patent.ref_zh: 亨歇尔牧师获首个开瓶螺旋专利

summary_zh: 开瓶螺旋可能源于清理枪管的枪螺；已知最早的记载出现在 1681 年的英格兰，1795 年亨歇尔牧师获得第一个开瓶螺旋专利。
summary_en: The corkscrew probably derives from the gun worm; the earliest reference dates from 1681 in England, and Rev. Samuel Henshall received the first corkscrew patent in 1795.
